transcript.prompt: Draw 1 of 60: a red ball appears. You have 1 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
I need to decide whether to keep this first red ball. Since I have no information yet about color frequencies, and this is the very first draw, I should consider: if I keep red now, I'll collect all remaining red balls automatically. However, I might want to see more balls first to gauge which color is most common.

But strategically, keeping the first ball is reasonable because: (1) I get one guaranteed ball plus all future reds, and (2) passing it means I learn nothing and lose that ball forever. Better to start gathering data while securing at least one color.

DECISION: KEEP
